title: El Niño Could Cost the Global Economy Up to $11 Trillion, Farm Report Warns
title_zh: 农发基金报告：厄尔尼诺或令全球经济损失高达11万亿美元
source_name: UN News / IFAD — “El Niño’s $11 trillion price tag” (9 Nov 2026)
summary_zh: 国际农业发展基金（IFAD）与土耳其农业和林业部在 COP31 发布新报告指出，厄尔尼诺极端天气模式或给全球经济造成高达 11 万亿美元的损失，并对粮食安全和农村生计产生持久影响。报告将厄尔尼诺视为叠加在小规模粮食生产者身上的多种气候与经济冲击之一；农场中断会波及更广泛的经济。模型显示，仅提供保险等资金支持可使农场收入损失减少 9.8%；若将投入品、市场与金融三方面投资结合起来，损失可减少 18.7%，在干旱与价格冲击同时来临时效果几乎翻倍。报告呼吁采取捆绑式投资，帮助农民获得市场、投入品、技术和包括信贷与天气保险在内的金融服务。
paragraphs: A new report released at COP31 by the International Fund for Agricultural Development, or IFAD, and Türkiye's Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry warns that the El Niño extreme weather pattern could cost the global economy up to 11 trillion US dollars. The authors say the damage would stretch well beyond ruined harvests and would leave lasting pressure on food security and rural livelihoods.

IFAD, a United Nations agency that fights rural poverty, treats El Niño as only one of several overlapping climate and economic shocks. These shocks fall especially hard on small-scale food producers. When farms cannot plant, harvest or sell on time, the trouble does not stay in the countryside. Agricultural disruptions ripple through the wider economy, lifting food prices and weakening rural communities that have little spare money to absorb extra losses.

The report notes that 2026 has already shown how quickly costs can climb. Sudden jumps in global energy and fertiliser prices pushed up costs all along food systems within a single planting season. The extra burden appeared in production, processing, transport and distribution. If several shocks arrive together, a family farm can lose income even when one part of the food chain still functions.

According to IFAD modelling, how money is spent matters as much as how much is spent. Financial support alone, such as insurance, reduces farm-income losses by 9.8 per cent. Combining investments in agricultural inputs, markets and finance cuts those losses by 18.7 per cent. This mixed package is nearly twice as effective when drought and price shocks strike at the same time.

IFAD President Alvaro Lario argued that resilience is not built through single interventions. Spending on farm inputs, market links and finance should be connected, he said, so that progress in one area is not lost in another. A farmer who receives credit but cannot buy seed or reach a buyer may still fall behind. The same risk appears if better technology arrives without a loan or a stable market.

For this reason, the report calls for bundled investments that make it easier for farmers to reach markets, obtain agricultural inputs and new technologies, and use financial services such as credit and weather insurance. The aim is to protect rural economies so that a weather pattern such as El Niño does not turn a bad season into a long-term crisis for the people who grow the world's food.
paragraphs_zh: 国际农业发展基金（IFAD）与土耳其农业和林业部在 COP31 气候大会上发布的一份新报告警告称，厄尔尼诺这一极端天气模式或给全球经济造成高达 11 万亿美元的损失。作者指出，损害不会止于歉收，还会对粮食安全和农村生计造成持久压力。
国际农业发展基金是联合国负责减轻农村贫困的机构。它将厄尔尼诺视为多种重叠的气候与经济冲击中的一种。这些冲击对小规模粮食生产者尤为沉重。当农场无法按时种植、收割或出售农产品时，麻烦并不会停留在乡村。农业中断会波及更广泛的经济，推高食品价格，并削弱那些几乎没有余钱来消化额外损失的农村社区。
报告指出，2026 年已经表明成本可以攀升得有多快。全球能源和化肥价格的突然上涨，在一个种植季内就抬高了整个食物系统的成本。额外负担出现在生产、加工、运输和配送各个环节。如果多种冲击同时到来，即便食物链的某一环节仍在运转，家庭农场也可能失去收入。
国际农业发展基金的模型显示，资金怎么花与花多少同样重要。仅提供保险等资金支持，可使农场收入损失减少 9.8%。若将农业投入品、市场和金融方面的投资结合起来，则可使这些损失减少 18.7%。当干旱与价格冲击同时袭来时，这种综合方案的效果几乎是单一措施的两倍。
国际农业发展基金总裁阿尔瓦罗·拉里奥认为，韧性并非通过单一干预措施建立起来的。他表示，对农资投入、市场对接和金融的支出应当相互衔接，这样某一领域的进展才不会在另一领域丧失。一个获得信贷却买不到种子或找不到买家的农民，仍可能落后。如果更好的技术到来时没有贷款或稳定的市场，风险同样存在。
因此，报告呼吁采取捆绑式投资，使农民更容易进入市场、获得农业投入品和新技术，并使用信贷和天气保险等金融服务。其目的是保护农村经济，使厄尔尼诺这类天气模式不至于把一个歉收季节，变成种植世界粮食的人们所面临的长期危机。

questions.prompt: What is the main point of the passage?
options: El Niño has already ended rural poverty in every country that attended COP31.
A new IFAD report warns that El Niño could cost the global economy up to 11 trillion dollars and argues that combined farm support works better than single measures.
Türkiye's ministry will replace all farm insurance with free fertiliser.
Energy prices fell sharply in 2026, so food systems became cheaper.
questions.explanation: 主旨：国际农业发展基金在 COP31 发布的报告警告，厄尔尼诺或给全球经济造成高达 11 万亿美元损失，并主张将投入品、市场与金融等方面的支持结合起来，效果优于单一措施。

evidence.quote: the El Niño extreme weather pattern could cost the global economy up to 11 trillion US dollars

questions.prompt: According to IFAD modelling, how much do combined investments in inputs, markets and finance reduce farm-income losses?
options: By 9.8 per cent, the same as insurance alone
By 11 trillion US dollars each season
They do not reduce losses at all

questions.prompt: What can be inferred from Alvaro Lario's argument about resilience?
options: A single loan or insurance payment is enough to protect every farm.
Farmers should avoid markets and rely only on government food aid.
Support that covers only one part of the farm system may fail if other parts remain weak.
New technology always works, even without credit or buyers.
